title: The Landscape of Chaos
introduction:
展览前言｜失序之境

秩序，是在既定规则下形成的一种有组织的生活状态，也是一种内在的和谐、宁静与稳定。然而，在人生起伏变化的过程中，我们的生活与内心世界总会一次又一次地陷入失序与混乱之中。

尽管传统美学往往追求和谐与秩序之间的平衡，但混沌并不意味着艺术价值的缺失。在谢一可与林凡宇的艺术创作中，文化身份、自我与他者之间的议题，都在一种混沌的状态中逐渐显现。

事实上，每一次混沌都如同一次涅槃。当我们真正接纳混沌，并感受到其中真实的生命力时，它便会转化为生命与艺术表达的养分，并在其中孕育出一种不同于以往的新秩序……
introduction-en:
EXHIBITION FOREWORD | THE LANDSCAPE OF CHAOS
Order is an organized state of life under the established rules, and it is also a kind of inner harmony, tranquility, and stability. In the ups and downs of life, our lives and inner world will enter a chaotic state of loss of order again and again.
Although traditional aesthetics often seek a balance between harmony and order, chaos does not mean a lack of artistic value. In the art of Xie Yike and Lin Fanyu, the issues of cultural identity, self and other arise in a state of chaos. In fact, every chaos is like a nirvana, and when we truly accept chaos and perceive the true vitality within it, it becomes the nourishment of life and artistic expression, and gives birth to a different kind of order...
